completed_steps: Inventoried and deeply audited all files in apps/web/src/components/visit/
Audited VisitSoapEditor.tsx, useVisitDiaryLogic.ts, useVisitSave.ts for cross-patient data leakage
Audited data loss prevention on tab switches, blur, pagehide, and beforeunload
Audited clinical quick presets (448 StomX templates + СтАР protocols)
Audited all action buttons (Save draft, Complete visit, Print Form 043/y) and eliminated unhandled rejections / premature modal closures
Audited CompletedServicesChecklist and VisitServiceBillingWidget for cashier handoff integrity
Fixed draft isolation key collision in VisitSoapEditor.tsx (visitId/patientId)
Fixed dente-apply-soap-protocol cross-component event contract mismatch
Fixed premature onClose before completion failure in VisitSummaryModal.tsx
Fixed pricing and 804n code synchronization between CompletedServicesChecklist and billing widget
Ran unit test suite (299 of 300 tests passed; 1 out-of-scope CBCT skipped per user ban)
Verified check:encoding (6715 files) and check:css-tokens (156 CSS files)
findings: Defect 1: LocalStorage draft collision in VisitSoapEditor due to key using only selectedTooth without visitId/patientId. Fixed with isolated prefix and fallback cleanup.

Defect 2: Cross-component protocol sync failure due to dente-apply-soap-protocol dispatching flat payload while editor strictly checked detail.soap. Fixed to support both flat and nested payloads with immediate flag.

Defect 3: VisitSummaryModal closed before completeVisit() finished, causing unhandled rejections and lost modal state on network error. Fixed by awaiting completion before closing with error handling.
Defect 4: Incomplete pricing attributes in CompletedServicesChecklist invoice dispatch. Fixed by including code804n, priceRub, and unitPriceRub.
